Verification documentation distinguishes internal outcomes, intentional exit/protocol changes, policy/exclusions and unverified Windows/hardware guarantees. No generated outputs or private machine configuration are tracked. Entire base-to-candidate diff is reviewed.

R14-setup-dependency.reviewed_assertions: Null/invalid setup create info, missing base pipeline, missing shader module and missing graphics/raytracing library dependencies retain setup or dependency-blocked as appropriate; do not dereference null create info or call Vulkan for blocked work. Include missing out-of-range library/dependency and required initial-object failure. Controlled run/device setup failure has unknown item identity and nonzero aggregate. Every failure has a valid-control counterpart.

R14-support.reviewed_assertions: Deterministically unsupported shader and graphics/compute/raytracing pipeline create-info produce unsupported, not validation/driver-crash, outcome even when progress is absent. Selected unsupported work returns nonzero; valid support control succeeds. Test a support rejection in a main-thread initial object callback as well as worker setup.

R14-validation.location: test/replay_outcome_test.cpp (new private production-inclusion target); test/replay_outcome_cli.cmake and test/replay_outcome_compatibility_test.cpp (new or equivalent committed registered fixtures)
R14-validation.reviewed_assertions: Invalid SPIR-V with FOSSILIZE_REPLAYER_SPIRV_VAL ON and --spirv-val uses the real validator and records validation-failed; a valid minimal shader control succeeds. Trigger actual on_validation_error callback during shader/pipeline creation via a deterministic dispatch adapter; retain validation failure even when Vulkan returns VK_SUCCESS. Blocked downstream pipelines are dependency failures, not their own compiler crashes.

R14-vulkan-create.reviewed_assertions: For graphics, compute and raytracing, inject at least VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY and VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST through actual production creation calls; assert creation-failed outcome, exact raw value/tag/hash, nonzero aggregate, null outputs and cleanup. Add shader-module and initial-object creation rejection controls so these cannot disappear through callback true/parse success. Successful creation remains zero and preserves outputs/lifetimes.

R14-worker-queue.reviewed_assertions: Run actual worker threads over fixed mixed parse/create jobs using one and multiple threads, both memory contexts, successful and failed processing, and shared progress null/present. Assert queued_count==completed_count==the exact submitted work count in every drained context; retained result remains unsuccessful. Include a completely successful queued workload returning zero. Use barriers/watchdogs, no random instability or timing sleeps.
